verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. In both, the subtitle 'Golden-hour botanicals.' is tiny and stranded at the bottom left, cut off from the 'Glow' headline it belongs to. The product is shrunk and pushed against the left edge, the CTA is crammed near the right edge on top of the busy circle, and the middle is mostly empty. A is very slightly better because its CTA has a bit more right margin; B's button nearly touches the edge and its subtitle sits even lower. A's subtitle does have an odd gap after 'Golden-'.
